item: IPCC SPM click surface (API + Advanced panel) and three hardening follow-ups
summary: POST /api/ipcc/spm/{key}/fetch (409 names airplane mode, 400 without consent) runs as a single-run writer job so two clicks cannot both insert; GET /api/ipcc/spm lists what is stored locally; Advanced panel with ensureOnline-gated button and the disclosure visible; the response is closed when raise_for_status fails; a hostile Content-Encoding is bounded and printable in the error. Strings x12.
